info.title: fsgg-coord-engine — the typed coordination engine (ADR-0034), and the client it becomes (ADR-0040).
info.description: FS-GG typed coordination engine — the schedulability model behind `fsgg-coord` as one total function over a board-state snapshot, plus the typed IO layer that drives it. It IS the coordination tool (ADR-0034/ADR-0040): the `fsgg-coord` shim resolves and execs it; there is no bash left to shadow.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
`scripts/fsgg-coord` is the client you run today; this is the engine it shells out to, and — at the
Phase D shim — the engine it BECOMES. The DECISION commands read state on stdin and touch nothing. The
CLIENT commands read and write GitHub through the typed IO layer.
